title: ComplexIF: A Challenging Multi-Turn, Multi-Constraint Instruction-Following Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.29775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As frontier LLMs saturate existing instruction-following benchmarks, measuring further progress requires harder tests that remain faithful to real use. In practice, users often combine several constraints, add them at different turns of a conversation, and expect all of them to hold in the assistant's response. We introduce ComplexIF, a challenging benchmark for this setting, together with the automatic pipeline that generates it. The pipeline expands seed requests into multi-turn conversations, weaves constraints into their turns, and keeps only tasks that a strong model can solve, so difficulty can be raised by adding constraints or turns while every task stays solvable. ComplexIF's two splits test complementary sides of instruction following: a verifiable split of format constraints, checked by programs, and a rubric split of semantic instructions, such as a tone or an audience, checked with an LLM judge. translated_title: ComplexIF：一个具有挑战性的多轮、多约束指令遵循基准
translated_abstract: 随着前沿大语言模型在现有指令遵循基准上趋于饱和，要衡量进一步的进展，就需要更难但仍忠实于真实使用场景的测试。在实践中，用户常常将多个约束组合在一起，在对话的不同轮次中陆续提出这些约束，并期望助手的回复能够同时满足所有约束。我们提出了ComplexIF，一个针对这一场景的具有挑战性的基准，并配套了生成该基准的自动化流水线。该流水线将种子请求扩展为多轮对话，把约束编织进对话的各轮次中，并只保留强大模型能够解决的任务，因此可以通过增加约束或轮次来提升难度，同时保证每个任务都是可解的。ComplexIF的两个子集分别测试指令遵循的互补方面：一个可验证子集包含格式约束，由程序进行检查；另一个评分准则子集包含语义指令（例如语气或目标受众），由LLM裁判进行评估。在对14个专有与开源模型的评估中……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: ComplexIF是一个自动化生成的多轮、多约束指令遵循基准，通过程序验证的格式约束和LLM裁判评估的语义指令两个互补子集，在贴近真实使用场景的前提下为大模型提供更具挑战性的测试。
en_tdlr: ComplexIF is an automatically generated multi-turn, multi-constraint instruction-following benchmark that challenges LLMs under realistic usage through two complementary splits—program-verifiable format constraints and LLM-judged semantic instructions.
